outcome: Pelvic floor muscle (PFM) function (maximum contraction and endurance)
Perceived level of difficulty in performing PFM contraction
cohort: The study included 42 women, with 17 diagnosed with stress urinary incontinence (research group) and 25 without SUI (control group).
finding: Women with SUI demonstrated lower PFM function, specifically in standing and sitting positions, compared to women without SUI, and PFM function varied significantly across different body positions in both groups, with the best contraction observed in standing and weakest in lying.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at a single point in time during the study assessment.
